description: Diagnostic module to verify attestation_refresher.py is properly registered in supervisord and has recent heartbeats. Queries service_health for attestation_refresher entry age, checks for log file existence, and verifies module integrity. Exports run() that writes diagnostic blob to service_health meta column. Does NOT rebuild or modify attestation_refresher.py (file is protected). Reports wiring status: 'unregistered', 'stale', or 'healthy'. Related to freshness SLA enforcement per spec section 4.
